citations.excerpt: In one sense the Free Church of Scotland dated its existence from the Disruption of 1843
in another it claimed to be the rightful representative of the National Church of Scotland (see Scotland, Church of ) as it was reformed in 1560.

facts.value: Asserted the independence of the church and its right to a spiritual jurisdiction answerable to its Divine Head alone.

citations.excerpt: the independence of the church, her inherent scriptural right to exercise a spiritual jurisdiction in which she is responsible to her Divine Head alone, was both earnestly asserted and practically maintained.
